description: This file defines an abstract base class 'SampleBase' for Vulkan sample applications, including methods for setup, rendering, resource management, and swapchain handling. It also includes macros for error handling and utility functions, and references external Vulkan and Android native window headers.

classes.name: SampleBase
classes.description: An abstract class providing an interface and common functionality for Vulkan-based sample applications, including lifecycle management, resource creation, and rendering.

methods.name: CleanUp
methods.description: Cleans up resources used by the application.

methods.name: SetWindow
methods.description: Associates an Android native window with the application.
